sanskrit: sundaraṃ kuṃḍamākhyātaṃ piśācamocanaṃ tathā | nīlagaṃgā iti proktā karkarājamataḥ param || 3 || puṣkarāṇi ca sarvāṇi gayātīrthamanuttamam | gomatīkuṇḍamākhyātaṃ nāmnā dharmasarastathā || 4 || khyātaṃ saṃgamajaṃ tīrthaṃ śanerjanmakathāṃ śubhām | cyavanāśrame ca yā vārtā tathā nāgālaye śubhe || 5 ||
english: The beautiful Kuṇḍa Piśācamocana has been described. Nīlagaṅgā and Karkarāja mentioned thereafter, all the Puṣkaras (holy lakes), the excellent Gayā Tīrtha, Gomatī Kuṇḍa and the lake named Dharmasaraḥ [Dharmasaras?], the Tīrtha arising from the confluence and the story of the birth of Śani—all these have been described, I wish to know what happened at Cyavana’s hermitage as well as at the splendid abode of Nāgas as also the greatness of Puruṣottama. What will happen, how and at what time as well as whatever you have in (your) mind (may be described).
